item.title: Cops: Riverhead man charged with murder in death of his mother
item.description: Suffolk County Police arrested Curtis Trent Jr., 36, of Riverhead and charged him with second-degree murder in the death of his mother, Kathleen Harrison Trent, whose body was found Feb. 11 in a wooded area in Manorville, police said.

item.title: Black ice possible early Thursday as temperatures drop below freezing: NWS statement
item.description: Rapidly falling temperatures early Thursday could lead to patches of black ice on area roads and sidewalks, according to a special weather statement issued by the National Weather Service in Upton.

item.title: Police: Two women wanted for shoplifting at Polo Ralph Lauren Children’s store in Riverhead
item.description: Suffolk County Crime Stoppers and Riverhead Town police are seeking the public’s help to identify two women accused of stealing about $585 worth of clothing from the Polo Ralph Lauren Children’s Factory Store in Riverhead.

item.title: Scammers are posing as town officials in phishing scheme targeting planning/zoning applicants
item.description: Riverhead Town officials are sounding the alarm about an email phishing scam targeting local residents, asking them to wire money to pay application fees for variances and other approvals.

item.title: Nathan T. Corwin III, 61
item.description: Nathan T. Corwin III of Riverhead died Feb. 25, 2026. He was 61 years old.

item.title: Peconic Landing seeks applicants for 14th annual ‘Veterans Day Wedding Giveback’
item.description: Peconic Landing is currently seeking applicants for the annual Veterans Day wedding giveback contest.

item.title: NY drivers now face steeply increased points for several serious driving offenses
item.description: Drivers ticketed for a range of serious traffic offenses in New York now face higher point penalties under revised DMV regulations that became enforceable last week.

item.title: Riverhead Police report: Shoplifting, DWI, domestic incidents declined in January
item.description: Riverhead Police reported 113 criminal offenses in January, down from 164 a year earlier, a 31% drop.

item.title: Reports of masked agents, arrests in Riverhead Friday morning
item.description: There have been multiple reports of ICE activity in Riverhead Friday morning, including one of a man tackled by agents after a foot chase across a busy West Main Street intersection near the Riverhead library.

item.title: Kathleen M. Harrison Trent, 63
item.description: Kathleen M. Harrison-Trent of Calverton died Feb. 11, 2026. She was 63 years old.
